tools.name: list_pricing
tools.description: Current plans and prices in USD: plan, interval, amount_usd, currency, what_you_get. No account needed.

tools.description: Public URL a human opens to choose and pay for a plan. Read-only: creates no charge and needs no card.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Find pages on this site by keyword; returns url, title and summary.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Current plans and prices in USD (monthly/yearly/one-time). No account needed." → after: "Current plans and prices in USD: plan, interval, amount_usd, currency, what_you_get. No account needed."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
